app.name: Glassys
app.tagline: A chat face for systems work on your machine
setup.title: Create operator account
setup.body: Glassys always uses its own password, even if you put Access or another proxy in front.
login.title: Sign in
wizard.title: Set up this space
wizard.adapter.body: Pick which agent should do systems work on this host. Same UI protocol for every adapter. Changing adapter starts a new thread.
wizard.adapter.unavailable: This adapter is not available on this host.
wizard.adapters.failed: Could not load adapters. Check that the gateway is running.
wizard.adapters.empty: No adapters are registered on this gateway.
wizard.workspace.body: Absolute path on the host where the agent reads and writes files.
wizard.workspace.required: Enter an absolute workspace path on this host.
wizard.acp.commandRequired: ACP needs a command (or a registry pick) before you can enter chat.
wizard.workspace.browseFailed: Could not list workspaces under that folder.
wizard.cred.body: Use this host’s SDK sign-in or API key when possible. An API key is optional (CI, or an override).
wizard.cred.loginUrl: If a browser did not open on the gateway host, open this URL here (phone, SSH, or systemd without a display):
wizard.cred.loginTimeout: Sign-in timed out. Open the URL above or paste an API key.
wizard.cred.loginHint: Mints ~/.cursor/sdk/auth.json via Cursor.auth.login(). IDE app login and cursor-cli / cursor-agent are a different store. Optional env:
wizard.cred.keyConfigured: Optional API key is stored on the server
wizard.cred.signedOut: No SDK session on this host yet
wizard.cred.keyHint: Leave empty to use the SDK login or the matching environment variable.
wizard.cred.unsignedWarn: Sign in with the SDK or set an optional API key before entering chat.
wizard.cred.required: This adapter needs an SDK sign-in or an API key before you can enter chat. Vendor CLI / IDE login is not enough.
wizard.model.body: Cursor, Claude, and OpenCode load models from the selected runtime’s live catalog. Gemini, Codex, and ACP use a static list; fallback is only a warning when a live catalog is expected.
wizard.model.empty: No models in the catalog yet.
boot.unreachable: The gateway is not reachable. Start it and retry.
wizard.model.required: Pick a model before entering chat.
wizard.model.fallback: Live catalog unavailable — showing adapter defaults. Sign in or check the API key.
wizard.rules.body: Which on-disk rule layers to load (Cursor). Default is project + user.
wizard.exec.body: With auto-run and a host workspace, this is operator access to that machine.
wizard.exec.danger: Cursor’s headless SDK cannot pause for your approval. Turning auto-run off uses Auto-review, which denies risky calls instead of asking. Sandbox off plus a public bind is dangerous.
wizard.exec.unattended: This adapter has no deny lever. Tools run as the vendor allows — Glassys cannot Auto-review them.
wizard.exec.permission.hint: Headless Claude Code cannot prompt you. Bypass runs tools unattended. Don’t-ask denies anything that would need a human OK.
wizard.acp.body: ACP speaks JSON-RPC on stdio. With auto-run on, Glassys applies file and terminal requests (no Apply/Reject UI). With auto-run off, writes and terminals are denied. Paste a command or pick a registry agent in Settings later.
wizard.acp.needsCommand: Pick a registry agent or enter a command in the next step.
setup.error: Could not create the operator account.
chat.empty: Send a message to start this thread.
chat.sendFailed: Not connected — message was not sent.
chat.queuedHint: Send now to queue the next message.
chat.attachPathOnly: This adapter receives file paths in the prompt, not native image parts.
chat.transcriptTruncated: Older messages were omitted. Export the thread for the full transcript.
chat.adaptersFailed: Could not load adapters. Sandbox and auto-run controls are hidden until this succeeds.
error.attachments: Could not read the attached file(s).
error.cwdNotDir: Workspace path is not a directory.
error.uploadMime: Only jpeg, png, webp, gif, and text/log uploads are allowed.
error.scheduleXor: A schedule needs either a cron expression or a one-shot time.
error.notGitClone: This install is not a git clone.
error.upgradeDirty: Working tree is dirty. Commit or stash before upgrading from the PWA.
chat.stalled: No output from the agent for a while. You can wait or cancel.
palette.title: Commands
settings.notifyHint: Uses Web Push. Needs HTTPS (or localhost) and, on iPhone, the installed PWA. Behind a LAN bind, put a tunnel or proxy in front.
settings.notifyNeedSw: Install the PWA (production build) to enable push.
settings.promptsHint: Typing / at the start of a message inserts a template. The text is sent to the agent in English.
settings.schedulesHint: Jobs wait until the gateway is idle. If the workspace differs, the live thread is archived first.
settings.scheduleCatchUp: Cron does not catch up missed fires while the gateway is down. One-shot times in the past run when it is idle.
settings.updateConfirm: Upgrade Glassys now? The gateway will rebuild and restart.
settings.updateDirty: Working tree is dirty. Upgrade from the PWA is blocked until you commit or stash.
settings.updateNeedService: Upgrade from the PWA needs the user service. Use pnpm run service:upgrade in the clone.
threads.title: Threads
threads.switchResume: Switching reopens that transcript and resumes the agent if the adapter allows.
threads.deleteConfirm: Delete this thread and its transcript? This cannot be undone.
threads.busy: Cancel the current run before switching threads.
reach.body: Open this origin on your phone. Bind, port, and public URL stay in config.yaml — not in the PWA.
reach.loopback: The gateway is bound to loopback. Edit bind in config.yaml or GLASSYS_BIND, and put a proxy in front, before a phone on another device can reach it.
reach.qr: QR code for this Glassys URL
chip.archiveConfirm: Changing sandbox, auto-run, or permission mode archives this chat and starts a new thread. Continue?
thinking.label: Thinking
settings.title: Settings
settings.archiveConfirm: Changing adapter, workspace, or agent options archives this chat and starts a new thread. Continue?
settings.restartRequired: Bind or port changed. Restart the gateway to apply.
settings.cred.fromEnv: This adapter’s API key comes from the environment. Rotating the stored key will not override it until that env var is unset.
settings.newThread: Changing adapter, workspace, or any agent option (sandbox, auto-run, rule sources, permission mode, ACP command) archives this chat and starts a new thread. The old transcript stays in the thread list. Changing model applies on the next message.
settings.hostLabelHint: Shown in the chat topbar. Does not change the product name.
settings.clearKeyWarn: The stored API key will be cleared when you save.
settings.passwordHint: Saving a new password signs other sessions out.
protocol.incompatible: This PWA is not compatible with the gateway protocol.
confirm.title: Are you sure?
